#!/bin/sh
# Installs BetterDesk and joins it to <base> with an invite.
# The script works as long as the invite does.
set -eu

BASE='<base>'
CODE='{secret:invite_code}'

if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
	echo "Run this as root: curl -fsSL '$BASE/join/$CODE/install.sh' | sudo sh" >&2
	exit 1
fi
